# Profile

I am Professor of Urban Analytics at the Bartlett Centre for Advanced Spatial
Analysis (CASA), University College London. My research uses data and
quantitative methods — frequently in R — to understand cities, migration,
housing and the systems people create. I publish across migration modelling
(particularly spatial interaction models), housing and energy, gentrification,
synthetic data and the geographies of beer and brewing, and have a passion
for applied work in urban policy contexts.

# Grants

External grants total awarded as PI or Co-I since 2012: **£17,491,621.90**.

```{r grants}
# Hand-kept list: the authoritative record, since ORCID has no roles and
# not every grant is on it. Any ORCID grant that isn't matched here (by
# grant number in the title, or by title) is appended automatically, so
# new grants added to ORCID show up on the next build.
grants_manual <- tribble(
  ~start_year, ~title,                                                                                                        ~role_status,                                                       ~funder_value,
  "2024",      "Census Innovation at CeLSIUS (ES/Z502741/1)",                                                                  "Co-I; active",                                                     "£384,576",
  "2024",      "TRACK-UK: Synthesized Census and Small Area Statistics for Transport and Energy (ES/Z50290X/1)",                "Co-I; active",                                                     "£327,680",
  "2024",      "AI for Collective Intelligence (AI4CI) — UKRI AI Research Hub for Real Data (EP/Y028392/1)",                    "Co-I; Local PI for UCL branch; active",                            "£10,274,279 (UCL portion £980,391.77)",
  "2023",      "Pathways to socially equitable net-zero cities and regions — ESRC CASE PhD Studentship",                        "PI/Supervisor (Transport East partner); active",                   "£93,633.90",
  "2023",      "Equity Assessment of Demand-side Flexibility Technologies in Grid Integrated Transport Electrification (PhD)",  "PI/Supervisor (EPSRC CREDS); active",                              "£96,044",
  "2022",      "NARRATE",                                                                                                       "PI; complete",                                                     "£142,739.24 (Ordnance Survey)",
  "2020",      "dunnhumby PhD Studentship",                                                                                     "PI/Supervisor (industry-funded); complete",                        "£60,000 (dunnhumby)",
  "2020",      "CeLSIUS (ES/V003488/1)",                                                                                        "Co-I; active",                                                     "£2,160,348.40 (ESRC)",
  "2019",      "YOUR.VU.CITY (UKRI 105325)",                                                                                    "Local PI (Co-I on whole project); complete",                       "£620,697 (UCL £159,996; Innovate UK)",
  "2018",      "CeLSIUS Re-commissioning (ES/R00823X/1)",                                                                       "Co-I; complete",                                                   "£1,020,753 (ESRC)",
  "2018",      "Colouring London Impact Acceleration Grant",                                                                    "PI; complete",                                                     "£55,200 (EPSRC)",
  "2016",      "CeLSIUS Extension Grant",                                                                                       "Co-I; complete",                                                   "£247,182.40 (ESRC)",
  "2016",      "Colouring London",                                                                                              "PI (with Co-PI Polly Hudson); complete",                           "£58,400.74 (Historic England)",
  "2014",      "RGS Innovative Teaching Grant",                                                                                 "PI (Co-I Paul Turner, Bedales School); complete",                  "£1,000 (RGS)",
  "2013",      "SYLLS — Synthetic data estimation for the UK Longitudinal Studies",                                             "PI; complete",                                                     "£272,652.73 (ESRC)",
  "2012",      "CeLSIUS (ES/K000365/1)",                                                                                        "Co-I; complete",                                                   "£1,676,436 (ESRC)"
)

# Grant numbers of ORCID entries to leave off the CV.
orcid_grants_hide <- character(0)

funder_abbrev <- c(
  "Economic and Social Research Council"              = "ESRC",
  "Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council" = "EPSRC",
  "Natural Environment Research Council"              = "NERC",
  "Arts and Humanities Research Council"              = "AHRC",
  "Medical Research Council"                          = "MRC",
  "UK Research and Innovation"                        = "UKRI",
  "Innovate UK"                                       = "Innovate UK"
)

manual_keys <- norm_key(grants_manual$title, 30)
in_manual <- function(id, title) {
  (!is.na(id) && any(grepl(id, grants_manual$title, fixed = TRUE))) ||
    norm_key(title, 30) %in% manual_keys
}

grants_orcid <- orcid_funds |>
  filter(!grant_id %in% orcid_grants_hide,
         !mapply(in_manual, grant_id, title)) |>
  mutate(
    funder = coalesce(funder_abbrev[funder], funder),
    start_year   = as.character(start_year),
    title        = ifelse(is.na(grant_id), title,
                          paste0(title, " (", grant_id, ")")),
    role_status  = ifelse(!is.na(end_year) &
                            end_year < as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")),
                          "complete", "active"),
    funder_value = ifelse(is.na(amount), funder,
                          paste0(ifelse(currency %in% "GBP", "£",
                                        paste0(currency, " ")),
                                 vapply(amount, format, character(1),
                                        big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
                                 " (", funder, ")"))
  ) |>
  select(start_year, title, role_status, funder_value)

bind_rows(grants_manual, grants_orcid) |>
  arrange(desc(as.integer(start_year))) |>
  detailed_entries(
    what  = role_status,      # bottom line (small caps)
    when  = start_year,
    with  = title,            # top line (bold)
    why   = funder_value
  )
```

```{r talks}
# Talks given with a full date ("4 Nov 2026") are labelled upcoming until
# the day has passed. The CV rebuilds daily, so the label drops off by
# itself; month-only dates ("Sept 2025") are never labelled.
talk_day <- as.Date(talks$when, format = "%d %b %Y")
talks$when <- ifelse(!is.na(talk_day) & talk_day >= Sys.Date(),
                     paste(talks$when, "(upcoming)"), talks$when)

talks %>%
  detailed_entries(
    what  = what,
    when  = when,
    with  = where
  )
```

# Selected Publications (since `r CV_PUBS_SINCE`)

A full list is available via [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.co.uk/citations?user=P_sHtmkAAAAJ&hl=en)
and [ORCID 0000-0001-8036-0185](http://orcid.org/0000-0001-8036-0185).

```{r selected-pubs}
# Pulled from ORCID, so new papers appear on the next build. To drop a
# paper from the CV (it stays on the website), add its DOI, or the start
# of its title, to cv_pubs_exclude.
cv_pubs_exclude <- c(
  "Our vulnerable high streets",
  "10.5281/zenodo.4664620",                                     # GISRUK 2021 housing affordability
  "10.1177/0308518X19880211",                                   # Visualising urban gentrification
  "Exploring local authority travel time",                      # 2020 working paper
  "Delineating the spatio-temporal pattern of local authority"  # 2020 working paper of the 2021 article
)

is_excluded <- function(title, doi) {
  ex <- tolower(cv_pubs_exclude)
  (!is.na(doi) & tolower(doi) %in% ex) |
    vapply(tolower(title), function(t) any(startsWith(t, ex)), logical(1))
}

orcid_pubs |>
  filter(year >= CV_PUBS_SINCE,
         !type %in% c("dissertation-thesis", "preprint"),
         !is_excluded(title, doi)) |>
  mutate(authors     = vapply(authors, cite_authors, character(1)),
         title_venue = cite_venue(title, journal, doi)) |>
  detailed_entries(
    what  = title_venue,
    when  = year,
    with  = authors
  ) |>
  cv_italics()
```
